interpretations: Group results across all years by `races.name`; select names whose summed `results.points` exceed the mean of those name-level totals; return the sum of their points, the average `results.laps` per driver result, and the mean points above that threshold per selected name.
Use the same name-level points threshold, but calculate average laps by first averaging `results.laps` within each selected race name, then giving each name equal weight.
Use the same name-level points threshold, but calculate average laps as the mean of each selected race name’s total completed laps across its driver results.

Treat each `races.raceId` as a separate race occurrence, even when names repeat across years; select occurrences whose total `results.points` exceed the mean occurrence total, then combine their points, average driver-result laps, and average excess points in one row.
Use the race-name points threshold, but average `results.laps` within each selected race occurrence, then give each occurrence equal weight.
Use the race-name points threshold, but total `results.laps` within each selected race occurrence, then average those occurrence totals.
queries:
WITH name_totals AS (
    SELECT
        races.name,
        SUM(results.points) AS total_points,
        SUM(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) AS total_laps,
        COUNT(results.laps) AS lap_count
    FROM races
    JOIN results ON results.raceId = races.raceId
    GROUP BY races.name
)
SELECT
    SUM(total_points) AS total_points,
    SUM(total_laps) / SUM(lap_count) AS average_laps,
    AVG(total_points) AS mean_points_per_name
FROM name_totals
WHERE total_points > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM name_totals)

WITH selected_names AS (
    SELECT r.name, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.name
    HAVING SUM(res.points) >= :points_threshold
)
SELECT AVG(average_laps) AS average_laps
FROM selected_names;

SELECT AVG(total_laps) AS average_laps
FROM (
    SELECT r.name, SUM(CAST(res.laps AS INTEGER)) AS total_laps
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.name
    HAVING SUM(res.points) > :points_threshold
)

WITH occurrence_totals AS (
    SELECT raceId, SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM results
    GROUP BY raceId
),
mean_total AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_points) AS points_per_occurrence
    FROM occurrence_totals
),
selected_occurrences AS (
    SELECT o.raceId, o.total_points
    FROM occurrence_totals AS o
    CROSS JOIN mean_total AS m
    WHERE o.total_points > m.points_per_occurrence
)
SELECT
    SUM(s.total_points) AS combined_points,
    (
        SELECT AVG(CAST(r.laps AS REAL))
        FROM results AS r
        JOIN selected_occurrences AS selected ON selected.raceId = r.raceId
    ) AS average_driver_result_laps,
    AVG(s.total_points - m.points_per_occurrence) AS average_excess_points
FROM selected_occurrences AS s
CROSS JOIN mean_total AS m

WITH qualifying_names AS (
    SELECT r.name
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.name
    HAVING SUM(res.points) > :points_threshold
),
race_totals AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, SUM(CAST(res.laps AS INTEGER)) AS total_laps
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN qualifying_names AS q ON q.name = r.name
    JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    GROUP BY r.raceId
)
SELECT AVG(total_laps)
FROM race_totals
